# sigma_reports (Data Source)

Lists Sigma reports. Results preserve Sigma API order; key collections by returned IDs rather than positional indices. Pagination cursors and page sizes are not exposed; this data source retrieves every page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sigma_reports" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exclude_tags` (Boolean) Whether to exclude tags (`excludeTags`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Archived filter (`isArchived`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.
- `skip_permission_check` (Boolean) Whether to skip permission checks (`skipPermissionCheck`). Explicit `false` is sent; null omits the parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identifier for this data source.
- `reports` (Attributes List) Reports in API order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reports))

<a id="nestedatt--reports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reports`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `created_by` (String) Creator member ID.
- `description` (String) Report description.
- `id` (String) Report ID.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the report is archived.
- `latest_version` (Number) Latest report version.
- `name` (String) Report name.
- `owner_id` (String) Owner member ID.
- `path` (String) Report path.
- `tags` (Attributes List) Version tags on the report. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reports--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Update timestamp.
- `updated_by` (String) Last updater member ID.
- `url` (String) Report URL.
- `url_id` (String) Report URL ID.

<a id="nestedatt--reports--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reports.tags`

Read-Only:

- `source_version` (Number) Source version.
- `tag_name` (String) Tag name.
- `tagged_at` (String) When the report was tagged.
- `tagged_report_id` (String) Tagged report ID.
- `version_tag_id` (String) Version tag ID.
